text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while heading back from an 
errand with Admire Vega...
Ayabe-oneecha~~n!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry~! The moment my twins saw 
you, Ayabe-chan, they just dashed right 
over!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
We're heading to the aquarium right now～! 
Come along with us, Ayabe-oneechan!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: Hey, please, please, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! I told you not to cling onto 
Ayabe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'how'... It doesn't look 
like they're gonna let me go...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then there's nothing we can do about it, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, everyone arrived at the aquarium 
together.
choice_data_list:
Your little sisters have really taken a 
shine to you, huh.

Your little sisters have really taken a 
shine to you, haven't they.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, yeah! Actually, a little while 
ago—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! There you are...! I'm so 
sorry...! It's because I took my eyes off 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, Ayabe-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're here... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Ayabe-neechan! Tell me more 
stories about the stars next time, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Y-Yeah... What do you mean? What 
about the stars...?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
You know, while I was wandering around 
looking for you, Big Sis, Ayabe-oneesan 
brought me right here!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
She told me big sis would come if I waited 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"While we waited, she told me sooo many 
stories about the stars~♪"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...and that's what happened!
choice_data_list: And so, they took a liking to you...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sis Ayabe. How do you read 
this? Are there bugs in it...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's read as "tako" (octopus). It's not 
a bug.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~! Ayabe-onee-chan, come here! 
Hurry, hurry! There's a fish with pretty 
colors~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"You don't have to rush so much, the fish 
isn't going anywhere..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well? How's your long-awaited whale omelet 
rice? Is it yummy?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's so yummy~♪ Oh, Big Sis Ayabe, 
do you want some too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, look this way... You've got 
ketchup on your mouth."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. Dolphin came right over here~~! 
Whoa~! What an amazing jump!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this position might be a little bad, 
nano...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Big Sis Ayabe! Ah, but wait! 
You're soaking wet, Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I'm so sorry, okay!? Come over 
here, Ayabe-chan!! I have a towel for 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-chan, thanks for today! You both 
looked like you were having so much fun! 
It's been so long since I saw you having 
such a blast!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sis Ayabe and everyone 
else! Let's play again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's truly... exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's truly... exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's no point if we're the only ones 
having fun, is there...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still... it wasn't bad, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
